post.text: Can you believe this was made by nature? https://t.co/kf4lDE3EPr

description.description: These frames show a person discovering and opening a geode. In the first frame, a person is seen pouring a liquid from a plastic bottle onto a dark brown rock located on a rocky riverbed. In the second frame, the person has picked up the rock and is holding a hammer, which they then use to strike the rock in the third frame. In the final frame, the rock has been split open, revealing two halves of a geode containing vibrant purple crystals and a red inner center, held in the person's hands.
